I replied to Ilse in the DM to confirm I'll keep the possible #7917 number for the Marrow Fieldworks West yard Door 2 double-booking to that conversation only. I didn't save it anywhere else: no GBrain note, no channel post, no mail. I also told Ilse I won't treat it as the real ticket number until it's confirmed somewhere the team can see.

When I checked GBrain first, the only related item was a #central-random export where Tobias says he logged the Door 2 issue on ticket #8841. It doesn't say which account that was. I left it out of my reply because I haven't checked whether Ilse is in that channel. GBrain was also running keyword-only search, so it may have missed related notes.
